rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something comes into view or appears.

example.english: You can see a bright star emerge in the night sky.
example.traditional: 你可以見到一粒好光嘅星喺夜空出現。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 jat1 nap1 hou2 gwong1 ge3 sing1 hai2 je6 hung1 ceot1 jin6

rows.note: Use this when someone or something comes out of a place, object, liquid, or situation.

example.english: Lava is starting to emerge from underground.
example.traditional: 熔岩開始由地底出嚟喇。
example.jyutping: jung4 ngaam4 hoi1 ci2 jau4 dei6 dai2 ceot1 lai4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when information or a fact becomes known by spreading among people.

example.english: The truth began to emerge once the news spread, and the whole neighborhood knew.
example.traditional: 呢個消息一傳開，成個街坊都知喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 jat1 cyun4 hoi1 seng4 go3 gaai1 fong1 dou1 zi1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when a hidden truth, answer, or picture gradually becomes apparent rather than simply being reported.

example.english: The truth gradually began to emerge.
example.jyutping: zan1 soeng3 zuk6 zim6 fau4 jin6
